# Provenance { #timetoalign.core.Provenance }

```python
core.Provenance()
```

How an item was made (paradata) and who believes it.

Every key is optional, but an entry states at least one. The format
records a person who states an item with the belief ``"true"``, and a
loader or a service with how the item was made and no belief.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name      | Type                                                                    | Description                                                                                                                                                              |
|-----------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| stated_by | [tuple](`tuple`)\[[str](`str`), ...\] \| None                           | Who stated the item (IRIs), at least one, each once.                                                                                                                     |
| date      | [str](`str`) \| None                                                    | When it was stated, written ``YYYY-MM-DD``.                                                                                                                              |
| method    | [str](`str`) \| None                                                    | How: one of TimeToShare's method words (``"manual"``, ``"reconciled"``, ``"imported"``, ``"inferred"``) or an IRI naming another method.                                 |
| service   | [str](`str`) \| None                                                    | The service or software that made it (an IRI), never empty.                                                                                                              |
| basis     | [tuple](`tuple`)\[[str](`str`), ...\] \| None                           | The sources it rests on (IRIs), at least one, each once.                                                                                                                 |
| match     | [str](`str`) \| None                                                    | For a reconciled value, how closely it matches its source: one of TimeToShare's SKOS mapping words (``"exact"``, ``"close"``, ``"broad"``, ``"narrow"``, ``"related"``). |
| note      | [str](`str`) \| None                                                    | Free text.                                                                                                                                                               |
| beliefs   | [tuple](`tuple`)\[[Belief](`timetoalign.core.provenance.Belief`), ...\] | Who believes the item, at most one :class:`Belief` per actor, in the order given.                                                                                        |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> entry = Provenance(service="https://example.org/aligner", method="inferred")
>>> entry = entry.with_belief(
...     Belief(actor="ana", belief="unlikely", date="2026-11-20")
... )
>>> entry.with_belief(
...     Belief(actor="ana", belief="false", date="2026-11-21")
... ).get_belief("ana").belief
'false'
>>> entry.passes_belief_filter("ana"), entry.passes_belief_filter("ana", "true")
(True, False)
```

### passes_belief_filter { #timetoalign.core.Provenance.passes_belief_filter }

```python
core.Provenance.passes_belief_filter(
    believer,
    belief='not_false',
    *,
    context=None,
)
```

Whether the belief filter for *believer* keeps the item.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type                                                                              | Description                                                                                                              | Default       |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------|
| believer | [str](`str`) \| None                                                              | The actor whose beliefs filter; ``None`` keeps all.                                                                      | _required_    |
| belief   | [BeliefFilter](`timetoalign.core.provenance.BeliefFilter`)                        | ``"not_false"`` keeps what the believer does not believe ``false``; ``"true"`` only what the believer believes ``true``. | `'not_false'` |
| context  | [Mapping](`collections.abc.Mapping`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] \| None | The JSON-LD context under which actors compare as IRIs (:func:`belief_mask`).                                            | `None`        |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                                              |
|--------|----------------|----------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [bool](`bool`) | Whether the item passes, decided by :func:`belief_mask`. |

### to_dict { #timetoalign.core.Provenance.to_dict }

```python
core.Provenance.to_dict()
```

The entry as a JSON-safe dictionary, absent keys left out.

### with_belief { #timetoalign.core.Provenance.with_belief }

```python
core.Provenance.with_belief(belief)
```

A copy holding *belief*, which replaces its actor's earlier one.

Every other actor's belief stands, in its place; a new actor's
belief is appended.
